page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.vgn6i-m8-vws.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 10 dedicated physical cores with one thread per core, paired with 46.0 GB of system memory. The instance includes a fractional GPU configuration consisting of a 0.5x NVIDIA T4 GPU with 8 GB of VRAM. Local storage is not included, and the baseline network bandwidth is rated at 4 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear division between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core performance is relatively low, with stress-ng single-core and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the bottom 25% and bottom 10% categories, respectively. However, multi-core execution is more robust, with stress-ng multi-core, PassMark CPU, and database operations scoring in the middle 50% tier. Memory bandwidth tests for both small and large blocks also register average performance, though the PassMark memory score is positioned in the bottom 25%.

The inclusion of a fractional NVIDIA T4 GPU enables entry-level accelerated workloads. LLM inference benchmarks show average performance for small 135M models, but drop to the bottom 10% for medium 7B models. Ray tracing and image processing benchmarks fall within the average tier. This hardware profile presents a qualitative cost-efficiency tradeoff, offering access to dedicated GPU resources and 10 physical CPU cores without the expense of a full GPU allocation, making it suitable for lightweight GPU-accelerated tasks, static web serving, and moderate database operations rather than heavy single-threaded compute or large-scale AI inference.
